title: What Is MCP (Model Context Protocol)? Plain-English Guide for Developers
summary: MCP lets AI agents actually do things — read files, query databases, call APIs — instead of just telling you how. Here's how it works, why it matters, and how to set it up.
body_markdown: Function calling is OpenAI's approach to letting models invoke tools defined inline in the API request. MCP is a protocol layer above that — it standardizes how tools are discovered, described, and invoked across any AI client and any tool. A model still uses function calling (or equivalent) under the hood; MCP defines the contract that makes those calls portable across clients and servers. The practical difference: MCP tools work in Cursor, Claude Code, and ChatGPT without rewriting the integration for each one.
